prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1277; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's Narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Conroe, Texas, I observed two vehicles with visible damage consistent with a side impact. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that the traffic signal had been green for its direction of travel. Driver 2 was operating an SUV westbound and stated that the signal had changed before the vehicles entered the intersection. A passenger was seated in the front right position of Driver 2's vehicle and was not visibly injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and was evaluated at the scene by medical personnel before declining transport. Both drivers were cooperative. Skid marks were noted on the roadway leading into the intersection. Weather was clear and the pavement was dry. Photographs were taken of both vehicles and the intersection. Based on the physical evidence and statements, a citation was issued to Driver 2 for failure to yield the right of way. Traffic control at the intersection was maintained until both vehicles were cleared from the roadway.
